title: T1587.004 — Develop Capabilities - Exploits
subtitle: Watch an exploit travel from a private lab to a defended network.
aria: Animated diagram of the exploit life cycle: a developer finds a bug in an isolated lab, writes a proof of concept, turns it into a working attack tool, a vendor releases a patch, mass scanning starts, a server is exploited, the attacker moves inside the network, and the SOC contains the incident and learns from it.

steps.caption: A developer studies a file-converter service in an offline lab. After days of automated bug hunting (fuzzing), a memory bug appears that no one has published. nothing. This is the invisible stage
